repeat_comparisons.method: Reuse the same preserved integration test binaries; run after then before for both complete selection and isolated ledger, reversing the first measurement order. No concurrent build, race or other checks launched by this task. Every run used fresh private fixtures and count=1.

repeat_analysis.interpretation: Substantial run-to-run variation; initial complete slowdown not reproduced. Isolated ledger savings were small and in the same direction under both execution orders. Two pairs do not establish stable whole-selection speedup or explain the variation source.

decision.reason: Repeat did not reproduce complete slowdown and both isolated ledger pairs showed small savings. Preserve coverage-backed responsibility change without claiming stable whole-selection speedup. Previous rollback recommendation based on one slow complete sample was premature.
decision.unquantified_cost: Recovery manager is explicitly closed and later closed again by testManager cleanup. This redundant path is real, but has not been measured and does not explain the initial 31-second whole-selection difference.
